race.comment: Tough. CALLISTEMON (5) has been about the mark in two runs since a win at Narracoorte, beaten 2.5 lengths into fifth at Swan Hill last time out. She finds a winnable race and should take holding out up in trip. VERONA RUPES (1) is off a let up for this, back in trip from two sub-par runs over a bit further. He won over this route three back and looks well placed up on speed. KIKORANGI (4) has been close up in two runs in Adelaide his past couple and will roll forward here. He should give a sight. LOVE SPARKLES (6) is racing consistently without winning thus far, dropping back to the mile last time out at Moe. Better suited back out in trip today and she can put her best footy forward.
